description: The STARS4Water project deposits land-use fractions for seven European river basins: Danube, Drammen, Duero, East Anglia, Messara, Rhine and Seine. A public CSV reports crop, forest, grass, urban and other area shares every five years from 2016 to 2051; a ZIP supplies basin polygons. Its short README says the pathway is SSP2-RCP4.5 and gives a column-name pattern and basin-name join. Zenodo marks the release CC BY 4.0. A basin hydrology or irrigation simulation could use the fractions to vary land-cover assumptions while retaining a common spatial boundary. These are basin averages derived from the LUCAS LUC future land-cover product, not observed parcel-level transitions. The CSV and shapefile ZIP were not opened, so fraction sums, polygon joins and gaps remain unchecked. Upstream LUCAS LUC rights should be assessed separately. The related irrigation-demand deposit is a companion input with a separate DOI, already drafted in the first review; this land-cover series is distinct.
